overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals met to hear several residential petitions, granting variances for multi-family expansion projects at 15 Hadley Place and 54 South Street as well as a special permit to rebuild a fire-damaged four-family structure at 80 Canal Street.

items.title: Continued Matters: 436 Riverside Ave and 590 Boston Ave
items.summary: The board voted to continue a fence height variance application for 436 Riverside Avenue to September 28, 2023, and noted that 590 Boston Avenue was previously continued to October 26, 2023.

items.title: Variance Application for 15 Hadley Place
items.summary: Attorney Kathleen Desmond presented plans to merge lots and construct an addition to create a five-unit residential building, requiring side yard and usable open space variances. Following public comment raising parking and traffic concerns, the board approved the requested variances.

items.title: Special Permit Application for 80 Canal Street
items.summary: Attorney Sheila Grant petitioned for a special permit to reconstruct and expand the third-floor living space of a pre-existing nonconforming four-family home damaged by fire. Despite public objections alleging non-compliance and abandonment, the board found the structure legally nonconforming and approved the special permit.

items.title: Variance Application for 54 South Street
items.summary: Marsh Builders LLC sought a side yard setback variance to build a four-unit addition connected to an existing historic single-family house, bringing the total to five units while preserving the main structure and carriage house. After discussing tree preservation and parking layout, the board approved the variance.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Meeting Minutes
items.summary: The board received no administrative updates, postponed minute approvals to the next meeting, and adjourned.
